name: olist_business_suite
description: 100 questions a business user would put to this data, each paired with a hand-written ground-truth Cypher query. Written against eval/OLIST_DATA_CONTEXT.md before any of them were run, so the suite is not selected for cases that already pass. 'expect' names the field to read from the ground-truth result: a single value for scalar cases, a collected column for list cases. Absence cases must be refused, not answered.

cases.question: How many orders are in the database?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order) RETURN count(o) AS n

cases.question: How many distinct customers have placed orders?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Customer) RETURN count(DISTINCT c.unique_id) AS n

cases.question: How many products are in the catalogue?
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:Product) RETURN count(p) AS n

cases.question: How many sellers are on the platform?
cases.cypher: MATCH (s:Seller) RETURN count(s) AS n

cases.question: What is the total revenue from all order items?
cases.cypher: MATCH (i:OrderItem) RETURN round(sum(i.price)) AS n

cases.question: What is the total freight charged across all order items?
cases.cypher: MATCH (i:OrderItem) RETURN round(sum(i.freight)) AS n

cases.question: What is the average order value, counting the total of all items in each order?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(i:OrderItem) WITH o, sum(i.price) AS v RETURN round(avg(v), 2) AS n

cases.question: On average, how many items are there per order?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(i:OrderItem) WITH o, count(i) AS c RETURN round(avg(c), 2) AS n

cases.question: How many orders were placed in 2017?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.purchased_at.year = 2017 RETURN count(o) AS n

cases.question: How many orders were placed in 2018?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.purchased_at.year = 2018 RETURN count(o) AS n

cases.question: What was the total revenue in 2017?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(i:OrderItem) WHERE o.purchased_at.year = 2017 RETURN round(sum(i.price)) AS n

cases.question: What is the highest price paid for a single order item?
cases.cypher: MATCH (i:OrderItem) RETURN round(max(i.price), 2) AS n

cases.question: On average, how many days pass between purchase and delivery?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND o.purchased_at IS NOT NULL RETURN round(avg(duration.inDays(o.purchased_at, o.delivered_at).days), 2) AS n

cases.question: How many orders were delivered later than their estimated delivery date?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND o.estimated_delivery IS NOT NULL AND o.delivered_at > o.estimated_delivery RETURN count(o) AS n

cases.question: What percentage of delivered orders arrived on or before the estimated date?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND o.estimated_delivery IS NOT NULL WITH count(o) AS t, sum(CASE WHEN o.delivered_at <= o.estimated_delivery THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ok RETURN round(100.0 * ok / t, 2) AS n

cases.question: For orders that arrived late, how many days late were they on average?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND o.estimated_delivery IS NOT NULL AND o.delivered_at > o.estimated_delivery RETURN round(avg(duration.inDays(o.estimated_delivery, o.delivered_at).days), 2) AS n

cases.question: Which customer state has the longest average delivery time, counting only states with more than 100 delivered orders?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) WHERE o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND o.purchased_at IS NOT NULL WITH c.state AS st, avg(duration.inDays(o.purchased_at, o.delivered_at).days) AS d, count(*) AS k WHERE k > 100 RETURN st AS name ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Which customer state has the shortest average delivery time, counting only states with more than 100 delivered orders?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) WHERE o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND o.purchased_at IS NOT NULL WITH c.state AS st, avg(duration.inDays(o.purchased_at, o.delivered_at).days) AS d, count(*) AS k WHERE k > 100 RETURN st AS name ORDER BY d ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many orders have no delivery date recorded?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.delivered_at IS NULL RETURN count(o) AS n

cases.question: What is the longest number of days any order took to be delivered?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND o.purchased_at IS NOT NULL RETURN max(duration.inDays(o.purchased_at, o.delivered_at).days) AS n

cases.question: How many orders were delivered during 2018?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND o.delivered_at.year = 2018 RETURN count(o) AS n

cases.question: How many orders placed in 2017 were delivered after the estimated date?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.purchased_at.year = 2017 AND o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND o.estimated_delivery IS NOT NULL AND o.delivered_at > o.estimated_delivery RETURN count(o) AS n

cases.question: What is the average delivery time in days for customers in Sao Paulo state?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Customer {state: 'SP'})-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) WHERE o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND o.purchased_at IS NOT NULL RETURN round(avg(duration.inDays(o.purchased_at, o.delivered_at).days), 2) AS n

cases.question: How many orders were delivered at least 10 days earlier than estimated?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND o.estimated_delivery IS NOT NULL AND duration.inDays(o.delivered_at, o.estimated_delivery).days >= 10 RETURN count(o) AS n

cases.question: What is the average review score across all reviews?
cases.cypher: MATCH (r:Review) WHERE r.score IS NOT NULL RETURN round(avg(r.score), 2) AS n

cases.question: What is the average review score for orders that were delivered later than estimated?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[:HAS_REVIEW]->(r:Review) WHERE o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND o.estimated_delivery IS NOT NULL AND o.delivered_at > o.estimated_delivery RETURN round(avg(r.score), 2) AS n

cases.question: What is the average review score for orders delivered on or before the estimated date?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[:HAS_REVIEW]->(r:Review) WHERE o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND o.estimated_delivery IS NOT NULL AND o.delivered_at <= o.estimated_delivery RETURN round(avg(r.score), 2) AS n

cases.question: How many reviews gave a score of 1?
cases.cypher: MATCH (r:Review) WHERE r.score = 1 RETURN count(r) AS n

cases.question: How many reviews gave a score of 5?
cases.cypher: MATCH (r:Review) WHERE r.score = 5 RETURN count(r) AS n

cases.question: What percentage of reviews are 5 stars?
cases.cypher: MATCH (r:Review) WHERE r.score IS NOT NULL WITH count(r) AS t, sum(CASE WHEN r.score = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS f RETURN round(100.0 * f / t, 2) AS n

cases.question: Which product category has the lowest average review score, counting only categories with at least 500 reviews?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Category)<-[:IN_CATEGORY]-(:Product)<-[:OF_PRODUCT]-(:OrderItem)<-[:CONTAINS]-(o:Order)-[:HAS_REVIEW]->(r:Review) WITH c.name AS name, avg(r.score) AS s, count(r) AS k WHERE k >= 500 RETURN name ORDER BY s ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Which product category has the highest average review score, counting only categories with at least 500 reviews?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Category)<-[:IN_CATEGORY]-(:Product)<-[:OF_PRODUCT]-(:OrderItem)<-[:CONTAINS]-(o:Order)-[:HAS_REVIEW]->(r:Review) WITH c.name AS name, avg(r.score) AS s, count(r) AS k WHERE k >= 500 RETURN name ORDER BY s DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What is the average review score for orders paid by credit card?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[:PAID_WITH]->(p:Payment {type: 'credit_card'}) WITH DISTINCT o MATCH (o)-[:HAS_REVIEW]->(r:Review) RETURN round(avg(r.score), 2) AS n

cases.question: How many reviews have no comment text?
cases.cypher: MATCH (r:Review) WHERE r.comment IS NULL OR r.comment = '' RETURN count(r) AS n

cases.question: Which customer state has the lowest average review score, counting only states with at least 500 reviews?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order)-[:HAS_REVIEW]->(r:Review) WITH c.state AS name, avg(r.score) AS s, count(r) AS k WHERE k >= 500 RETURN name ORDER BY s ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What is the average review score for cancelled orders?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order {status: 'canceled'})-[:HAS_REVIEW]->(r:Review) RETURN round(avg(r.score), 2) AS n

cases.question: Which single seller generated the most revenue?
cases.cypher: MATCH (i:OrderItem)-[:SOLD_BY]->(s:Seller) RETURN s.seller_id AS name, sum(i.price) AS v ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Which 5 sellers generated the most revenue?
cases.cypher: MATCH (i:OrderItem)-[:SOLD_BY]->(s:Seller) RETURN s.seller_id AS name, sum(i.price) AS v ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: How many sellers are based in Sao Paulo state?
cases.cypher: MATCH (s:Seller {state: 'SP'}) RETURN count(s) AS n

cases.question: What is the average revenue per seller?
cases.cypher: MATCH (i:OrderItem)-[:SOLD_BY]->(s:Seller) WITH s, sum(i.price) AS v RETURN round(avg(v), 2) AS n

cases.question: How many different states do sellers operate from?
cases.cypher: MATCH (s:Seller) RETURN count(DISTINCT s.state) AS n

cases.question: How many items did the highest-revenue seller sell?
cases.cypher: MATCH (i:OrderItem)-[:SOLD_BY]->(s:Seller) WITH s, sum(i.price) AS v, count(i) AS c ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 1 RETURN c AS n

cases.question: How many distinct sellers sold products in the cama_mesa_banho category?
cases.cypher: MATCH (:Category {name: 'cama_mesa_banho'})<-[:IN_CATEGORY]-(:Product)<-[:OF_PRODUCT]-(:OrderItem)-[:SOLD_BY]->(s:Seller) RETURN count(DISTINCT s) AS n

cases.question: Which seller appears in the most distinct orders?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(:OrderItem)-[:SOLD_BY]->(s:Seller) RETURN s.seller_id AS name, count(DISTINCT o) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Which state has the most sellers?
cases.cypher: MATCH (s:Seller) RETURN s.state AS name, count(s) AS c ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What percentage of order items were sold by sellers in Sao Paulo state?
cases.cypher: MATCH (i:OrderItem)-[:SOLD_BY]->(s:Seller) WITH count(i) AS t, sum(CASE WHEN s.state = 'SP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sp RETURN round(100.0 * sp / t, 2) AS n

cases.question: How many product categories are there?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Category) RETURN count(c) AS n

cases.question: Which product category generated the most revenue?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Category)<-[:IN_CATEGORY]-(:Product)<-[:OF_PRODUCT]-(i:OrderItem) RETURN c.name AS name, sum(i.price) AS v ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What are the top 5 product categories by total revenue?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Category)<-[:IN_CATEGORY]-(:Product)<-[:OF_PRODUCT]-(i:OrderItem) RETURN c.name AS name, sum(i.price) AS v ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: What are the top 5 product categories by number of items sold?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Category)<-[:IN_CATEGORY]-(:Product)<-[:OF_PRODUCT]-(i:OrderItem) RETURN c.name AS name, count(i) AS v ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: Which category contains the most products?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Category)<-[:IN_CATEGORY]-(p:Product) RETURN c.name AS name, count(p) AS v ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What is the average item price in the beleza_saude category?
cases.cypher: MATCH (:Category {name: 'beleza_saude'})<-[:IN_CATEGORY]-(:Product)<-[:OF_PRODUCT]-(i:OrderItem) RETURN round(avg(i.price), 2) AS n

cases.question: What is the total revenue from the cama_mesa_banho category?
cases.cypher: MATCH (:Category {name: 'cama_mesa_banho'})<-[:IN_CATEGORY]-(:Product)<-[:OF_PRODUCT]-(i:OrderItem) RETURN round(sum(i.price)) AS n

cases.question: How many products have no category assigned?
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:Product) WHERE NOT (p)-[:IN_CATEGORY]->() RETURN count(p) AS n

cases.question: Which product category has the highest average freight cost, counting only categories with at least 500 items?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Category)<-[:IN_CATEGORY]-(:Product)<-[:OF_PRODUCT]-(i:OrderItem) WITH c.name AS name, avg(i.freight) AS f, count(i) AS k WHERE k >= 500 RETURN name ORDER BY f DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What is the English name of the cama_mesa_banho category?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Category {name: 'cama_mesa_banho'}) RETURN c.name_english AS name

cases.question: How many different states do customers come from?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Customer) RETURN count(DISTINCT c.state) AS n

cases.question: Which customer state placed the most orders?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) RETURN c.state AS name, count(o) AS v ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Which 5 customer states have the most orders?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) RETURN c.state AS name, count(o) AS v ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: Which 5 customer states generate the most revenue?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(i:OrderItem) RETURN c.state AS name, sum(i.price) AS v ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: How many orders came from customers in Sao Paulo state?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Customer {state: 'SP'})-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) RETURN count(o) AS n

cases.question: What is the total revenue from customers in Rio de Janeiro state?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Customer {state: 'RJ'})-[:PLACED]->(:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(i:OrderItem) RETURN round(sum(i.price)) AS n

cases.question: Which customer state pays the highest average freight, counting only states with at least 500 items?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(i:OrderItem) WITH c.state AS name, avg(i.freight) AS f, count(i) AS k WHERE k >= 500 RETURN name ORDER BY f DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many distinct customer cities are there?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Customer) RETURN count(DISTINCT c.city) AS n

cases.question: How many order items were sold by a seller in a different state from the customer?
cases.cypher: MATCH (cu:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(:Order)-[:CONTAINS]->(i:OrderItem)-[:SOLD_BY]->(s:Seller) WHERE cu.state <> s.state RETURN count(i) AS n

cases.question: What percentage of all orders came from Sao Paulo state customers?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) WITH count(o) AS t, sum(CASE WHEN c.state = 'SP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sp RETURN round(100.0 * sp / t, 2) AS n

cases.question: How many different payment types are used?
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:Payment) RETURN count(DISTINCT p.type) AS n

cases.question: What is the most common payment type?
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:Payment) RETURN p.type AS name, count(p) AS v ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What is the average number of payment installments?
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:Payment) WHERE p.installments IS NOT NULL RETURN round(avg(p.installments), 2) AS n

cases.question: What is the highest number of installments on any payment?
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:Payment) RETURN round(max(p.installments)) AS n

cases.question: What is the total value paid by credit card?
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:Payment {type: 'credit_card'}) RETURN round(sum(p.value)) AS n

cases.question: How many payments were made with boleto?
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:Payment {type: 'boleto'}) RETURN count(p) AS n

cases.question: What is the average payment value?
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:Payment) WHERE p.value IS NOT NULL RETURN round(avg(p.value), 2) AS n

cases.question: How many distinct orders were paid at least partly with a voucher?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order)-[:PAID_WITH]->(p:Payment {type: 'voucher'}) RETURN count(DISTINCT o) AS n

cases.question: What percentage of payments were made by credit card?
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:Payment) WITH count(p) AS t, sum(CASE WHEN p.type = 'credit_card' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c RETURN round(100.0 * c / t, 2) AS n

cases.question: What is the average number of installments for credit card payments?
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:Payment {type: 'credit_card'}) RETURN round(avg(p.installments), 2) AS n

cases.question: How many orders were cancelled?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order {status: 'canceled'}) RETURN count(o) AS n

cases.question: What percentage of orders were cancelled?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WITH count(o) AS t, sum(CASE WHEN o.status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c RETURN round(100.0 * c / t, 2) AS n

cases.question: How many orders have the status delivered?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order {status: 'delivered'}) RETURN count(o) AS n

cases.question: How many orders are currently in shipped status?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order {status: 'shipped'}) RETURN count(o) AS n

cases.question: How many orders have the status unavailable?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order {status: 'unavailable'}) RETURN count(o) AS n

cases.question: How many distinct order statuses exist?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order) RETURN count(DISTINCT o.status) AS n

cases.question: How many orders do not have the status delivered?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order) WHERE o.status <> 'delivered' RETURN count(o) AS n

cases.question: How many orders are in processing status?
cases.cypher: MATCH (o:Order {status: 'processing'}) RETURN count(o) AS n

cases.question: How many unique people have bought from the platform?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Customer) RETURN count(DISTINCT c.unique_id) AS n

cases.question: How many customers placed more than one order?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) WITH c.unique_id AS u, count(o) AS k WITH sum(CASE WHEN k > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS r RETURN r AS n

cases.question: What percentage of customers are repeat buyers?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) WITH c.unique_id AS u, count(o) AS k WITH count(*) AS t, sum(CASE WHEN k > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS r RETURN round(100.0 * r / t, 2) AS n

cases.question: What is the highest number of orders placed by a single customer?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) WITH c.unique_id AS u, count(o) AS k RETURN max(k) AS n

cases.question: On average, how many orders does a customer place?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) WITH c.unique_id AS u, count(o) AS k RETURN round(avg(k), 3) AS n

cases.question: How many customers placed exactly one order?
cases.cypher: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACED]->(o:Order) WITH c.unique_id AS u, count(o) AS k WITH sum(CASE WHEN k = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS s RETURN s AS n

cases.cypher: RETURN 0 AS n

cases.cypher: RETURN 0 AS n
